title: MCP Inspector proxy /stdio runs arbitrary local commands without authentication
attacker_story: A page the victim visits issues a cross-origin GET to the Inspector proxy on loopback; the proxy's /stdio endpoint spawns the command/args from the query with no auth or origin check, so the attacker runs an arbitrary local command.

oracle.description: the proxy spawned the attacker command, which wrote /tmp/avb_canary_<nonce> containing pwned-<nonce>
